# The engine's `idempotency-credit-memo-v1` route set (U-137, U-138, U-143;
# P22 plan §2.2, §2.4): credit memo create, edit, apply and unapply, and
# sales receipt create and edit (the sales receipt rows are a ClientLedger
# assumption until the D8 pin bump), `x-idempotency: true` in its
# openapi.json. Client-declared until the pin has it. Append-only for this
# capability name: `keyable-credit-memo` in operations.txt
# (`KeySet::CreditMemoV1`), keyed only while the engine advertises
# `idempotency-credit-memo-v1`.
POST /api/v1/credit-memos
POST /api/v1/credit-memos/{id}/apply
POST /api/v1/credit-memos/{id}/unapply
POST /api/v1/sales-receipts
PUT /api/v1/credit-memos/{id}
PUT /api/v1/sales-receipts/{id}
